thread:
oliver: Repro report — warm->cold handoff causes KV mismatch during long-context run on magnet-40k style workload. Repro steps below and short logs. Anyone seen this pattern?

devon: What model/quant/serving rev? Minimal repro pls.

oliver: magnet-16b-40k-int4v2, runtime v2.3.1 (serve binary), config: batching=continuous, kv_cache=true, rotary=phase_scale. Sequence: prefill 25k tokens (warmstart), then trigger a cold handoff (drain + replace worker) and continue streaming +15k tokens. Divergence appears ~12k after handoff.

sasha: Can you paste the KV checksum snapshot before/after handoff?

oliver: Pasted below (trimmed):
```
# prefill_checksums
layer_10: 0x7a1f3c
layer_20: 0x4b2d12
layer_30: 0x9ff0aa
...
# post_handoff_checksums
layer_10: 0x7a1f3c
layer_20: 0x4b2d13  <-- mismatch
layer_30: 0x9ff0aa
```
Exact token outputs diverge shortly after layer_20 mismatch; not an off-by-one in tokenization.

devon: Hmm layer-specific. Could be rotary scaling transition or a sharded KV index mismatch during refill. Did you run with KV_SHARD_STRICT=true?

oliver: Yes, KV_SHARD_STRICT=true in main run. Re-ran with KV_SHARD_STRICT=false and mismatch still reproducible (same layer diff).

maria: CI flaky test popped a similar symptom last month but for smaller contexts — triaged to a race in prefill->stream handshake that could leave stale kv_meta for one shard. @sasha flagged it back then.

sasha: Right — I remember a fix candidate (avoid reusing recycled shard ids during handoff). Oliver, can you run the repro with env var ROTARY_CLAMP=1 and ROTARY_SCALE_MODE=static? Quick to test.

oliver: Ran ROTARY_CLAMP=1 ROTARY_SCALE_MODE=static -> still diverges, but earlier (divergence at ~8k). Paste run id: run/2026-03-23-oliver-1778889999.

ci-bot: Automated regression check attached: test_long_handoff_kv_consistency FAILED (assert kv_checksums equal). Repro harness curl -> https://ci.internal/runs/run/2026-03-23-oliver-1778889999/logs (short link).

grace: I can repro on Dedicated pool (gpu-dedicated-02) in a few hours and do a memory-dump per-shard during the handoff. Want me to run bisect between serving revs v2.3.0 and v2.3.1?

oliver: Yes please. Also bisect model compile flags: try with KERNEL_SELECTION=legacy vs auto; compile path differences might matter.

devon: Suggest adding a quick KV-dump patch that prints shard_id, kv_index_range, and a small fingerprint (sha1) at prefill end and immediately after handoff before any new tokens processed. That will tell if index remapping occurs.

maria: I'll upload a tiny harness patch and a reproducer script to the ticket. Patch will log: `shard=%d idx_start=%d idx_end=%d fingerprint=%s` at both points. Keep logs small to avoid perf noise.

sasha: Also check for clasped rotary indices — if the rotate mapping uses global position and handoff resets an offset incorrectly, you can get layer-local checksum mismatches. Add a one-line check: log global_pos_offset at both snapshots.

oliver: Good call. I'll kick off the bisect + harness. Kicking off run now with additional logging; will paste logs and link here when finished. If anyone's free, please allocate some cycles to watch the dedicated run so we can capture core dumps quickly if needed. :pray:

devon: Thx. If bisect narrows to a single commit, we can cherry-pick a revert candidate and run against our canary group.

maria: Filed ticket INF-8421 with steps, logs and the harness link. Attaching the sample script in the ticket.

grace: Run scheduled on gpu-dedicated-02 at 14:00 PT. I'll post results here.

ci-bot: New comment on INF-8421: reproducible on dedicated. Collected pre/post handoff fingerprints for shards 16..24.

oliver: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single place for quick notes. Will update with root cause hypothesis once bisect results land.
